title: Deepa's Monumenta Pack
description: A QOL polish and immersion focused mod-pack for the Monumenta MMO-RPG Minecraft server.
body:
Deepa's Monumenta Pack is an unofficial performance, quality of life, polish and immersion focused mod-pack for the Monumenta MMO-RPG Minecraft server.

## Welcome to Monumenta!
Monumenta is a Minecraft survival-mode combat-focused dungeon-crawler with RPG elements. Fight monsters, get loot, play with friends, Complete the Monument!

Monumenta is forever free to play, not for profit, and developed by the community.

# About this Modpack
This modpack is meant to be the ultimate immersive new player experience for the Monumenta server, giving just a base polished experience without the extra bells and whistles such as extra interface information elements or certain helper features.

The modpack includes many Monumenta specific mods like the Unofficial Monumenta mod, Monumenta Addons, Monumenta Item Dictionary, USBPlus, and several of vladomemes off-platform mods and forks for Monumenta.

Many other QOL mods and the best of performance mods are also included for a smooth experience on the server.

All of the mods required to use every feature of the official Monumenta resource pack are present, and properly configured to cause no graphical issues, having everything display and perform as intended.

Custom buttons and information prompts are added to certain interfaces for shortcuts to useful Monumenta tools, commands, and helpful information about the Modpack.

Other resource packs and my own edits and fixes of them are included for a clean, immersive, fantasy oriented interface to ensure immersion and visibility.

This pack would also serve as a nice base to edit, adding and removing resourcepacks, mods, configuring, or whatever else you'd like to do with it!

## Important Notes
When updating this modpack note that all configs that might've been updated will not apply their changes to your instance, this is done so you can edit them freely without overwriting. If you want the new files to replace yours, I'd suggest reinstalling the modpack and moving your relevant files over to the new instance.

I am not affiliated with the developers of Monumenta and this modpack is entirely unofficial! For a more barebones resourcepack with performance mods and the resourcepack essentials, [find the official modpack here!](https://modrinth.com/modpack/official-monumenta-modpack)

The smoother glow resourcepack included is disabled by default, but can help alot with performance if you want many players glow visible at once. (There is a default keybind to toggle glowing players!)

The minimap is disabled by default but can be enabled through Xaero fairplay minimaps settings in the ingame mods menu or via settings keybind.

This modpack may not always have the latest official resourcepack, use /help rp on the server to check the latest!

### My recommended ingame settings (in game on Monumenta use `/player settings`)
- Gameplay/Combat Options
  - Ability hotbar > disabled
  - Inventory drink > enabled
- Technical Options
  - Spoof world names > enabled
  - Auto Abandon completed dungeons > disabled
- Trigger/Interactable Options
  - Block interactions > disabled (Prevents accidental ability casts with scythes, and opening unwanted interfaces in combat)
  - Offhand swapping > disabled
  - Offhand swapping in inventory > disabled (Both offhand keys can be annoying and cause accidental swaps, safer to swap offhand with mouse clicks)
